body:
lauren.p: NimbleAccel alerted us that theyre changing gateway headers and payload layout on 2026-05-15. They want marketplace images and partner SDKs to remain compatible. Can we outline a minimal plan?

mike.dev: Thin translation shim in marketplace image is fastest. Map old headers/payload to new shape. Easy rollback.

sanjay: Also prepare SDK fallback toggle so customers can opt in while they migrate. Shim + opt-in SDK is safer.

anna.docs: Ill prepare a short migration doc with curl examples and a small test harness. Need exact diffs from Nimble.

taylor.pm: Proposed dates: notice by 2026-03-30, shim canary 2026-04-08, docs 2026-04-18, SDK patch 2026-04-22, partner flip 2026-05-15, shim deprecated 2026-08-13.

helen.nimble: NimbleAccel spec link uploaded (internal): https://nimble/partner-spec/v2. Old header X-Accel-Version -> X-NA-Version; body field model_id -> meta.model_ref. Well keep legacy behavior for 90 days post-flip.

mike.dev: Will add unit tests + a contract test to partner pipeline. Plan env var REDWOOD_NA_COMPAT=true for SDK fallback; deprecate after 45 days.

lauren.p: Action owners: lauren.p send partner notice; sanjay open rollout ticket; mike.dev build shim + tests; anna.docs draft guide; taylor.pm coordinate announcement.

deploy-bot: marketplace-image/compat-shim deployed to canary (sha: d4e5f6a) at 2026-04-08T14:15:02Z :rocket:

lauren.p: Once PR merges Ill send partner-facing notice and the migration guide link. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
